besluite.rede: 'aan so 'n nuweling ... leen' already means lend, because 'aan' settles the direction, so 'uitleen' only reads differently and is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: Singular generic 'wie' is picked up by plural 'hulself', an agreement mismatch.
besluite.rede: A plural subject agrees with 'hulself' and still means whoever looked after the cattle, single person or family, so the meaning does not move and no protected word is touched.
